subject: Amendment required to draft Bill of Lading
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed the draft Bill of Lading against the Shipping Instruction, which serves as the authoritative reference, and found a few discrepancies that require correction.

For the Consignee, the Shipping Instruction states EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC, whereas the draft Bill of Lading shows UAB NOVAKOPA.

For the Notify Party, the Shipping Instruction states EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC, whereas the draft Bill of Lading shows UAB NOVAKOPA.

Please amend the draft Bill of Lading to match the Shipping Instruction at your earliest convenience.

Sincerely,

Shipping Operations
